description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying at most {4}{U}{U} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat from step 2.
